GAME.HEAD_DESCRIPTION: Onitama: a local two-player game in a Japanese ink dojo.

GAME.CLOCK_STARTS: The clock starts on the first move.

REASONS.CAPTURE: The opposing master has been captured.
REASONS.TEMPLE: The opposing temple has been reached.
REASONS.TEMPS: The opponent’s time has run out.

RULES_LIST.1: Two players share this screen. South plays the black pieces, North the red ones.
RULES_LIST.2: Select a card, then one of your pieces. The dots show the possible destinations.
RULES_LIST.3: The mini-grids are oriented like the board: North’s are flipped. The dark square is your piece.
RULES_LIST.4: An enemy piece on the destination is captured. You cannot take your own pieces.
RULES_LIST.5: The played card is swapped with the one in the center, then the turn changes.
RULES_LIST.6: Win by capturing the opposing master or by bringing your master into the opposing temple.
RULES_LIST.7: If no move is possible with your two cards, you must pass and exchange a card.

GAME.DURATION_HINT: The chosen duration will apply to the next game. The clocks keep running while menus are open.
